description: This PHP source file extends the functionality of a QuickEdit view in a CRM system, specifically for the Projects module. It defines a class ProjectViewQuickedit that customizes the display templates and behavior based on certain request parameters and properties of the bean, such as whether it is a template. The code overrides the preDisplay method to adjust templates and buttons dynamically.

classes.name: ProjectViewQuickedit
classes.description: A view extension class for the Projects module's quick edit functionality, enabling specialized behavior during save operations, especially handling template records.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Method that adjusts header and footer templates and default buttons based on the record's template status before the display is rendered.
